title: TCG: Scarlet & Violet Base Set
description: The expansion that launched the Scarlet & Violet era!

questions.question: When was the Scarlet & Violet base set released?
questions.explanation: Scarlet & Violet launched March 31, 2023, kicking off the SV era.

questions.question: Which new card mechanic debuted in Scarlet & Violet?
questions.explanation: Pokémon ex returned as a new mechanic in SV, replacing V and VSTAR cards.

questions.question: Koraidon and Miraidon both appear as ex cards in this set.
questions.explanation: The legendary Paldea cover Pokémon Koraidon ex and Miraidon ex both appear in the base set.

questions.question: Which Paldean starter is the Fire-type?
questions.explanation: Fuecoco is the Fire-type starter that evolves into Skeledirge.

questions.question: Scarlet & Violet base set retired the Pokémon V mechanic.
questions.explanation: With SV, V/VMAX/VSTAR cards were phased out and replaced by Pokémon ex.

questions.question: How many cards were in the base SV set (including secret rares)?
questions.explanation: The Scarlet & Violet base set contains 258 cards including secret rares.

questions.question: Which iconic Pokémon got a Special Illustration Rare in the SV base set?
questions.explanation: Pikachu received one of the most coveted Special Illustration Rare cards in the set.

questions.question: The SV base set introduced new rarity tiers like Special Illustration Rare and Hyper Rare.
questions.explanation: SV reorganized rarities, debuting Illustration Rare, Special Illustration Rare, and Hyper Rare tiers.

questions.question: Which Pokémon serves as the iconic full-art ex from the Violet half of the set?
questions.explanation: Miraidon ex represents Pokémon Violet's box legendary.

questions.question: Tera Pokémon were introduced in the SV base set as a card-type mechanic.
questions.explanation: Tera Pokémon ex cards, immune to damage while on the Bench, debuted in the base set.
